nodes.description: AggregatorInterface public oracle; address of the Chainlink aggregator being adapted
uint256 public priceMultiplier; scaling factor applied to oracle output (10 ** decimals)
ChainlinkOracleAdapterV2 constructor; sets oracle and priceMultiplier from deployer inputs
external view read(); reads oracle.latestAnswer(), casts to uint256 and multiplies by priceMultiplier
External call to untrusted oracle contract: oracle.latestAnswer() cast to uint256
Multiplication oracleOutput.mul(priceMultiplier) via SafeMath (arithmetic overflow guarded)
Exponentiation 10 ** _priceMultiplierDecimals (arithmetic; depends on deployer-supplied decimals)
library SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b): checked multiplication, reverts on overflow
library SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b): checked division, reverts on division by zero
library SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b): checked subtraction, reverts on underflow
library SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b): checked addition, reverts on overflow
library SafeMath.mod(uint256 a, uint256 b): checked modulo, reverts on division by zero
constructor parameter _oracle (AggregatorInterface) holding the aggregator address
constructor parameter _priceMultiplierDecimals (uint256) used to derive priceMultiplier
local variable uint256 oracleOutput = uint256(oracle.latestAnswer()) in read()
SafeMath.mul parameter a (uint256)
SafeMath.mul parameter b (uint256)
SafeMath.mul local variable c = a * b
SafeMath.div parameter a (uint256)
SafeMath.div parameter b (uint256)
SafeMath.div local variable c = a / b
SafeMath.sub parameter a (uint256)
SafeMath.sub parameter b (uint256)
SafeMath.sub local variable c = a - b
SafeMath.add parameter a (uint256)
SafeMath.add parameter b (uint256)
SafeMath.add local variable c = a + b
SafeMath.mod parameter a (uint256)
SafeMath.mod parameter b (uint256)
